description_en: Obtains temporary read/write authorization for file storage
description_zh: 获取文件存储临时读写授权
kebab_example: aliyun dataphin-public get-file-storage-credential --op-tenant-id 30001011 --project-id 1030131021 --use-vpc-endpoint true --purpose RESOURCE --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetFileStorageCredential

parameters.description_en: The project ID. This parameter is required when the temporary authorization is used to create resource files.
parameters.description_zh: 项目Id，临时授权用于创建资源文件时必填

parameters.description_en: Specifies whether to use an internal endpoint. Default value: false.

parameters.help_zh: 使用内网地址, 默认：false
parameters.name: use_vpc_endpoint

parameters.description_en:
The purpose of the authorization. Valid values:

- RESOURCE: creates resource files.
- COMPUTE_SOURCE_SETTING: stores compute source configurations.
- NONE: no specific purpose.

Default value: NONE.
parameters.description_zh: 用途: RESOURCE 创建资源文件、COMPUTE_SOURCE_SETTING 存储计算源配置、NONE 无明确用途；默认：NONE
